//: Fields of Salt's evaporation ponds (mod id fieldsofsalt, checked with its 1.3.0 release): recipes/evaporationpond says what a pond turns into what, a liquid in litres into an item, over evaporationTime hours. Sea water into salt is the one recipe. The game's salt has a base value (4), which a recipe never changes, so this lists the pond as a way to make salt (item reports' "Made by") without moving any value.

recipe.note: Left in the sun for its evaporationTime (game hours); time isn't charged.
